name: ammo
description: Run a staged, multi-agent campaign that profiles and optimizes Pumice inference latency on your own NVIDIA GPU host, inside a local Pumice checkout, with no server, container, or web UI. The campaign keeps the seven stages (baseline, bottleneck mining, debate, isolated implementation and validation tracks, integration, campaign evaluation), the fact-checked report, four independent audits, and five binding gates, and ships only changes that are production-active, correct, and statistically faster. Ships the lead skill (ammo:ammo), the report sub-skill (ammo:ammo-report), nine role agents (ammo:<role>), and the campaign hooks.
compatibility: Requires Claude Code plugin hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PreCompact, SessionStart, Stop, SubagentStop, WorktreeCreate, WorktreeRemove) registered in hooks/hooks.json, the registered ammo:* agent types (ammo:ammo-researcher, ammo:ammo-champion, ammo:ammo-impl-champion, ammo:ammo-transcript-monitor, ammo:ammo-auditor, ammo:ammo-delegate, ammo:ammo-investigator, ammo:ammo-resolver, ammo:ammo-report-writer), bash, jq, flock, git, and Python 3.11 or later. The campaign needs a pre-built Pumice checkout at the commit scripts/pumice_pins.py pins, with its venv (pumice and pumice_rust importable), cargo build --release done, model weights in a plain model directory, and NVIDIA GPUs with nvidia-smi; preflight checks these and pauses the campaign naming the gap. The runtime profile is pumice-cuda only. Graph validation (scripts/validate_pave.py) and the revision log tool (scripts/record_revision.py) need pyyaml and jsonschema and fail closed without them. The test battery needs uv, or pytest, pyyaml, jsonschema, pydantic, httpx, numpy, and psutil. On Codex, codex/install_agents.py installs the eleven ammo:* custom agents and codex/RUNTIME.md lists the settings.
